title: AUD-1.1's variant pairs v3 to v5: each violation query is unsat; the flawed forms' premises are unsat, with their minimal cores, and the sound forms' premises are sat; each step-3 scenario is covered or not
records: AUD-1.1 (content/audit/AUD-1.1.yaml): the violation, premise and core queries of variant pairs v3, v4 and v5, and the premise-plus-values query of each step-3 scenario
binary: libz3.so of the z3-solver 5.3.1 wheel in the statespace-bench image (/opt/venv/lib/python3.13/site-packages/z3/lib/libz3.so)
verdict_lines: [q7 s2 paid=100 refund=40 days=45] unsat (not covered)
[q7 s4 paid=20 refund=40 days=3] unsat (not covered)
[q8 s1 paid=100 refund=40 days=3] unsat (not covered)
[q8 s2 paid=100 refund=40 days=45] unsat (not covered)
[q8 s3 paid=100 refund=100 days=30] unsat (not covered)
[q8 s4 paid=20 refund=40 days=3] unsat (not covered)
[q9 core] unsat_core=['(= fee (div amount 100))', '(> amount 0)', '(>= fee amount)']
[q11 s2 bal=300 used=450 amount=100] unsat (not covered)
[q11 s4 bal=100 used=0 amount=150] unsat (not covered)
[q12 s1 bal=300 used=0 amount=200] unsat (not covered)
[q12 s2 bal=300 used=450 amount=100] unsat (not covered)
[q12 s3 bal=1000 used=100 amount=400] unsat (not covered)
[q12 s4 bal=100 used=0 amount=150] unsat (not covered)
notes: <sandbox>/work in argv stands for a fresh scratch copy of this run's inputs/ folder, mounted at /w; the inputs are kept under inputs/ as they ran.
Each log is the container's stdout followed by its stderr. verdict_lines are the lines of the log the recorder keeps (content/audit/tools/record-exemplars.mjs), copied in log order.

Every query runs under rlimit 5000000. q9 and q10 are q9.smt2 and q10.smt2, read one assertion at a time with parse_smt2_string, so each premise keeps the text the case shows; the last assertion is the violation.
